criterion: From the V4 launcher, open API Request Audit and verify that the module view loads without an application error.
steps_taken: Opened the V4 launcher and confirmed the API Request Audit tile was available.
Opened API Request Audit and confirmed its dashboard, request metrics, charts, and request explorer loaded without an application error.

criterion: From the first API Request Audit view, use the browser Back control and verify that the V4 launcher is visible.
steps_taken: Started from the V4 launcher, opened API Request Audit, and confirmed the module view loaded.
Used the browser Back control and confirmed the V4 launcher was visible at the launcher URL.

criterion: From the launcher reached by the browser Back control, open API Request Audit again in the same browser session and verify that the module view loads without an application error.
steps_taken: Captured the V4 launcher reached by browser Back in the same browser session.
Opened API Request Audit again and confirmed the dashboard metrics and request explorer loaded without an application error.
